description.en: The name of the access group that is associated with the mount target.

description.zh:
IPv4和IPv6双栈挂载点。

> 当前仅极速型NAS中国内地各地域支持IPv6功能。
description.en:
The domain name of the dual-stack mount target.

> The IPv6 feature is available only for Extreme NAS file systems in the Chinese mainland.

description.zh:
文件系统ID。
- 通用型NAS：`31a8e4****`。
- 极速型NAS：必须以`extreme-`开头，例如`extreme-0015****`。
description.en:
The ID of the file system.

- For a General-purpose NAS file system, the ID is similar to `31a8e4****`.

- For an Extreme NAS file system, the ID must start with `extreme-`, for example, `extreme-0015****`.
The domain name of the IPv4 mount target.

description.zh:
挂载点状态。

取值：

- Active：可用
- Inactive：不可用

> 当前仅通用型NAS支持更改挂载点状态。
description.en:
The status of the mount target.

Valid values:

- Active: The mount target is available.

- Inactive: The mount target is unavailable.

> You can change the status of a mount target only if the mount target is attached to a General-purpose NAS file system.

descriptions.zh: 仅支持修改通用型NAS或极速型NAS文件系统的挂载点信息。
descriptions.en: This operation applies only to mount targets on General-purpose NAS and Extreme NAS file systems.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas modify-mount-target --file-system-id 1ca4040000 --mount-target-domain 1ca404a666-w0000.cn-hangzhou.nas.aliyuncs.com --access-group-name classic-test --status Inactive --dual-stack-mount-target-domain 174494b666-x0000.dualstack.cn-hangzhou.nas.aliyuncs.com --access-point-access-only true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun nas ModifyMountTarget --region cn-hangzhou --Status Inactive --DualStackMountTargetDomain '174494b666-x0000.dualstack.cn-hangzhou.nas.aliyuncs.com' --MountTargetDomain '1ca404a666-w0000.cn-hangzhou.nas.aliyuncs.com' --AccessGroupName 'classic-test' --FileSystemId 1ca4040000 --AccessPointAccessOnly true
